𝐇𝐎𝐖 𝐓𝐑𝐔𝐌𝐏 𝐇𝐔𝐌𝐈𝐋𝐈𝐀𝐓𝐄𝐃 𝐄𝐔𝐑𝐎𝐏𝐄 𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐏𝐏𝐄𝐃 𝐗𝐈 𝐉𝐈𝐍𝐏𝐈𝐍𝐆—𝐀𝐋𝐋 𝐈𝐍 𝐎𝐍𝐄 𝐖𝐄𝐄𝐊

“40 𝘯𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘴. 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘯𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘢𝘤𝘵𝘶𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘴, 𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘯𝘦𝘥 𝘣𝘢𝘤𝘬 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘢𝘯𝘬𝘦𝘳𝘴, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘨𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘳𝘢𝘧𝘧𝘪𝘤 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘚𝘵𝘳𝘢𝘪𝘵 𝘣𝘺 650%—𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘜𝘯𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘥 𝘚𝘵𝘢𝘵𝘦𝘴 𝘕𝘢𝘷𝘺—𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘪𝘯𝘷𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘥.”

Iran’s foreign minister went on the record: 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐮𝐳 𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐲 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐧. Full capitulation. Oil prices crashed 11% in minutes. Iran agreed to suspend its nuclear program indefinitely.

While this was happening, Starmer and Macron hosted a 𝟒𝟎-𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐯𝐢𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐬𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐢𝐭 to launch a “Maritime Freedom of Navigation Initiative”—for a problem the US Navy had already solved. 𝟒𝟎 𝐟𝐥𝐚𝐠𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐳𝐞𝐫𝐨 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐲𝐞𝐫𝐬.

But the real play? 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐗𝐢 𝐉𝐢𝐧𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠. Panama pushed out of Belt and Road. Venezuela cut off from cheap Chinese oil. Defense deals with Indonesia and the Philippines locking down Malacca and the Luzon Strait. The US now controls the three biggest choke points feeding China’s oil tankers.

𝐈𝐫𝐚𝐧 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐦-𝐮𝐩. 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐚 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭—𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐗𝐢 𝐢𝐬 𝐚𝐥𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐜𝐮𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭.

data.text:
I was on the same flight as KaoJane from BKK to MNL (I saw them after disembarking; please refer to my work of art for details 😂), and they looked so damn exhausted. Seeing stars in person when they’re dressed in casual fits is surreal, because while exciting, it makes you realize that they’re human beings like everyone else. Don’t get me wrong, they’re gorgeous in real life, too; but when they were standing in that airport hallway, after an early morning flight, they looked so tiny—almost fragile—like they could barely hold themselves up from the sheer weight of work and other life responsibilities. I’m sure they wanted to curl up in a ball and rest (because that’s how I would feel), but they gracefully stood there while they were surrounded by fans taking photos and videos a few meters away from their faces, like an art exhibit. 

I remember telling my friends after KaoJane’s fanmeet that years of training and professionalism were evident in Kao and Jane’s performances, because when they were on stage, there was no trace of the 2 exhausted girls I saw at the airport the day before. Kao and Jane’s performances were fire; they gave it their all, and then some. Their fanmeet is hands down one of the best fanmeets I’ve ever been to (They had backup dancers! 🔥 I’ve never seen a fanmeet performance with backup dancers. And not just any backup dancers—GFORCE!! 🔥 It makes me wonder who ended up shouldering that expense because GFORCE is a well-known group in the PH, and their talent fee must have been a consideration.). 

All of this to say, that as someone who went to their fanmeet and saw the dedication and effort that KaoJane put in to make every fan have the best experience, I don’t doubt that the love they have for Filipino fans is the same love they have for all their supporters. I don’t think the lack of a Manila vlog changes that. 

Anyway that’s all have a good day! 😅💖
